label: isolation-1
hypothesis: If morphic resonance acts on physical randomness, a still life or oscillator that is made to occur hundreds of thousands of times by the trainer will be over-represented, in the same block, among the forms that emerge in the tester's pure-Conway soups drawn from OS entropy, relative to that form's count in blocks where another form was trained (T1, primary). Secondary (T2): a form's count rises with how many times it has been trained so far.
